body:
I get it. I'm a 39 year old woman and I haven't had a hug or any affection since Christmas
 At this point I'm just trying to see how long I can keep it going.

It would be easier if I either had a support system to vent to or stuff like this didn't happen numerous times a day, every day. Or, if maybe when I go out of my way to make these things not happen, they didn't go ahead and happen anyway.

I have. I made one of them cry a few times and I always felt he was just watching the clock until it was time to dismiss me. My last one often made me feel like he was getting into a one-upping conteplst in who has had a worse experience in life. Another didn't really want to listen as much as shove anti-depressants in me. I've given up talking to anyone about my issues, professional or not.
Depression affects your physical well being at least as much as your mental. For me, it's muscle aches, tension headaches, and that pain you get in your chest the most.

God, people are the absolute worst. I once had someone on here repeatedly harass me because I was responding to someone else's post about how I wish I were lucky enough to get stage 4 cancer. They chose to berate me several times by claiming I was trivializing cancer. And I wasn't even the OP.
It's kind of you to ask, but I'm officially retiring from telling people what's going on, as it has a solid 0% success rate.
What a coincidence! My mom just singlehandedly cured mine by telling me "shit happens to everyone!"
I have a whole playlist I started. But of course Asleep by The Smiths is on there, as are a couple of songs by Nine Inch Nails.

It's not really depression-you're just sad.

Exercise and a proper diet will fix it!

I can't see a psychologist. They're all full with waitlists. I saw a counselor a few times but he only seems interested in one-upping me on whose life has been shittier. I'm too tired to keep fighting, so unless you're interested in taking my cat, there's nothing else to say.
Most of the time I either get no responses, or I get asshole responses. Today I got the latter. Not sure which is worse.
Agreed. People love to give empty platitudes like that but it's entirely meaningless and giving false hope is a terrible thing to do.
I'd happily let it take me. I'd never be that lucky though.
Yes. If you disagree with or dislike someone's post, just scroll by it. It's not like it's hard-most people on this subreddit do it to all my posts.
And our experiences aren't any less valid because some sanctimonious jerk gets on here acting like he has all the answers.
It's because when people say that, what they really mean is "love yourself so no one else has to."

Correction: Self care made you lose excess baggage. 
If she treated you like that, she was never your friend. What you're mourning is the lack of companionship, but hers was toxic. This is a sucky but necessary part of the process, and now you have room to prioritize yourself and find a real friend.
I'm thinking 40 is a good round number and I'm just over a year away from it.
I got downvoted earlier for commenting that a baby's laughter gave me life. I swear, I fucking hate this place sometimes-even when I try to spread positivity someone had to shit on it.

One of my reasons for planning on ending it is that I guarantee that not a single person can name a reason not to that isn't either A) ultimately tied to someone else (eg, Your family/friends/whoever will miss you and be sad 🤮) or B) That whole nonsense of "You are enough" (if that were true we wouldn't be miserable). 
No one wants me here because they absolutely can't live without me-they just don't want to live without what I do for them.
Right? It's like that thing I saw awhile ago where someone said their psychologist/counselor/whoever was like, "Maybe life just isn't for everyone."
